sourceOmissions.safeSelectorPolicy: Standard element names, combinators and positional pseudo-classes only; IDs, classes and attributes removed.
sourceOmissions.auditOutcomes: Every audit outcome is retained. Unknown audit IDs receive an opaque alias. Image audits retain outcome metadata only.
sourceOmissions.errors: Known Lighthouse or runner error codes and presence/counts are retained. Free-form error and warning text is omitted explicitly.
sourceOmissions.details: Only allowlisted numeric measurements, structural containers and simplified selectors are retained.
sourceOmissions.authentication: Before/after proof retains only known roles, HTTP status codes, booleans and UTC observation/expiry times. Planned real renewal retains its fixed reason, times and success; identities and credentials are omitted.
sourceOmissions.note: A privacy-filtered derivative, not a raw Lighthouse report. Consult the separately protected raw report by its SHA-256 for omitted private details.

derivativePolicy: Upstream omissions remain. Identifiers/locations/provenance fingerprints are logicalized; no additional score, metric, audit, error or warning entry is dropped.
